slots.jd.staffing.about:
Position summary
Baxton Staffing Group seeks a Senior HR Business Partner to support managers and employees across a hybrid workforce based in Phoenix, AZ. The role partners with leaders on employee relations, hiring and benefits. Minimum: experience as an HR business partner, sound judgment on employee matters and clear written communication. Preferred: experience in a staffing company.
slots.jd.staffing.duties:
Responsibilities
- Screen candidates for open roles and coordinate next steps with hiring managers
- Advise managers on employee relations matters and recommend fair, consistent responses
- Answer employee benefits questions and explain coverage options clearly
- Guide managers through workplace concerns and document outcomes
- Partner with leaders on hiring plans and staffing needs
slots.jd.staffing.needs:
Minimum and preferred qualifications
- 8 or more years of human resources experience
- Senior HR Practitioner Certificate (required)
- Experience with Workday and applicant tracking systems
- Experience running new hire onboarding, performance review cycles and exit interviews
- Working knowledge of employee relations practice
- Preferred: experience in a staffing company
slots.r1.b1: Streamlines new hire paperwork by linking it directly to payroll coordination, reducing paperwork processing time by 20 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Schedules interviews with hiring managers and applies policy writing to set clear, consistent interview scheduling guidelines for the team.
slots.r1.b3: Resolves employee concerns early by building common questions into new hire onboarding, reducing repeat concerns from new staff by 50 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Maintains accurate HR records, logging findings from exit interviews so departure trends are documented and easy to review.
slots.r1.i1: Advises managers at Kestrel Works on people matters, drawing on policy writing, performance review cycles and exit interviews to help them reach fair and consistent decisions.
slots.r1.i2: Leads hiring plans with department heads at Kestrel Works, aligning open roles with each team's staffing needs.
slots.r2.b1: Rolled out policy updates alongside performance review cycles, raising on-time review completion by 10 percent.
slots.r2.b2: Answered staff benefits questions and wrote clear job postings that described benefits accurately for applicants.
slots.r2.b3: Screened candidates for open roles and drew on benefits administration knowledge to explain coverage, cutting offer declines by 25 percent.
slots.r2.b4: Processed new hire paperwork in Workday, keeping employee files complete before each start date.
slots.r2.i1: Handled new hire paperwork at Eastgate Regional Hospital, making sure each new employee's records were complete and accurate.
slots.r2.i2: Served as a contact for benefits questions at Eastgate Regional Hospital, helping staff understand their coverage and options.
slots.r3.b1: Scheduled interviews and handled payroll coordination for incoming staff, reducing scheduling delays by 40 percent.
slots.r3.b2: Addressed employee concerns and used policy writing to clarify the guidelines behind the most common questions.
slots.r3.b3: Kept HR records current by building record checks into new hire onboarding, lowering missing-document cases by 25 percent.
slots.r3.b4: Drafted policy updates informed by feedback gathered in exit interviews with departing employees.
slots.r3.i1: Answered benefits questions for employees at Lantern Hill, providing clear and timely responses on coverage and enrollment.
slots.r3.i2: Kept HR records organized and up to date at Lantern Hill, supporting accurate reporting.
slots.summary.1: Senior human resources professional with about 8 years of experience who sets how the team handles new hire onboarding, from first paperwork through Workday setup. Brings policy writing, benefits administration and payroll coordination skills to support managers and employees.
slots.summary.2: Human resources professional at the senior level with about 8 years of experience in Workday, new hire onboarding and policy writing. Sets how the team handles employee policy, writing clear guidance that managers and staff apply consistently.
